name: smwmusic-kero-blaster-true-identity
title: Kero Blaster - True Identity
description:
A creepy and tense song, predating unfortunate events, from Kero Blaster.
A small warning that this song's noise sample breaks completely, if you pause the game once, due to it using endless legato, so, unless you're using AMK 1.0.8. and beyond, or KevinM's patch that fixes this problem, be REALLY careful.
